text: Marcus and Ananya Reddy plan how the team will know any of this is actually working: Prometheus scraping metrics, Grafana dashboards, Alertmanager routing to Slack and PagerDuty.
The goal gets written down plainly: the team needs to know when customers can't actually complete a purchase -- not just when a server returns an error code.
Alerts route by severity -- Slack for warning-level, PagerDuty for anything that needs someone woken up.
The first concrete alert the team plans to build is a standard one: HTTP-level error rate. A reasonable starting point, not yet the full picture.
Next: the infrastructure itself, built for real in Terraform -- the VPC, the EKS cluster, ECR, and the database.
